name: RC04 free-form pilot manifest (frozen before the search)
evaluator: rcx/scenarios.py RC04.evaluate + rcx/constraints.py (unchanged), CARLA 0.9.15, Town04, dt 0.05, RC_SUBSTEP=0.002 RC_BRAKE_SCALE=3.0 RC_BRAKE_CAP_MAX=0.85
policy: free-v1: K=6 knots (0.1 s .. 5.1 s, 1.0 s apart), a_req in [-9, 2], lateral fraction in [-0.3, 1.2]; hard rate limits 8 m/s2 and 0.8 per knot interval; smoothness weight 0.2; continuation = hold last lateral target + speed hold at hand-over speed (rcx/free_policy.py)
world_notes: Hidden at the trigger (20RCs.md RC04): truck braking response 0..3 m/s2 (side_acc) and follower reaction 0.5..1.2 s (fol_react). The follower headway (0.8..1.6 s) is a parameter in rcx/rc04_laws.DEFAULTS but no law uses it, so it is not varied. Scenes without a follower drop the worlds that differ only in fol_react.

budget.free: iCEM pop 160, 9 iterations, 2 seeds (about 1500 robust evaluations x 5 perturbations)
budget.structured: iCEM pop 48, 8 iterations, 2 seeds per family, 3 families (about 1400 robust evaluations x 5 perturbations)

history: existing structured-family results of these scenes (results_search/rc04) are kept unchanged as historical evidence
